title: gNee (Global / General Network Environment Engine)
blurb: gNee (Global / General Network Environment Engine) is a unified GUI and CLI orchestration layer providing a single control surface for multi-site, multi-service infrastructure stacks including web, mail, SFTP, APIs, media streams, GPG keyservers, Bitcoin fullnodes, and Lightning nodes.
note: INTERNAL – Operator-centric control plane for private multi-site infrastructure.
